digests.title: TLDR Daily Digest
digests.tagline: AI, IT, Web Dev, InfoSec, Design, Data

stories.headline: OpenAI Begins Testing Private Inference
stories.blurb: OpenAI is evaluating Private Inference with select enterprise clients to run automated safety checks while keeping underlying content inaccessible to internal personnel.

stories.headline: Speculative Encoding Speeds Up Inter-Agent Context Sharing
stories.blurb: Ramp Labs introduced a translation method that maps hidden states directly between AI models, enabling agents to process long context windows up to four times faster than native prefill.

stories.headline: Anthropic Adds Skills and Async Tasks to MCP
stories.blurb: Anthropic released Skills over Model Context Protocol in public beta along with GA support for long-running background tasks, making it easier for Claude to execute multi-step workflows.

stories.headline: Sand AI Unveils 480B Video Model MAGI-2
stories.blurb: Sand AI launched a 480-billion-parameter model capable of generating 30-second 1080p video complete with synchronized dialogue and audio.

stories.headline: 1Password Discloses Employee Account Breach Impacting Backend Systems
stories.blurb: Attackers compromised a corporate GitHub account to access internal source code and user metadata, though customer secrets and vault contents remained fully protected.

stories.headline: Check Point Management Servers Targeted in AI-Assisted Attacks
stories.blurb: Threat actor GT13 exploited Check Point servers across multiple sectors using automated scanning and cookie forgery to gain SSH access and exfiltrate data.

stories.headline: State-Backed Hackers Adopt Autonomous ARTEX Pentesting Framework
stories.blurb: APT groups are leveraging the open-source ARTEX framework to orchestrate multi-tool attack chains at machine speed, presenting new detection challenges for defenders.

stories.headline: Researchers Demonstrate EDR Evasion via Signed Script Interpreters
stories.blurb: A novel technique leverages built-in foreign function interfaces in runtimes like Node.js, LuaJIT, and Bun to execute shellcode directly through Windows APIs without triggering typical security flags.

stories.headline: Anthropic Migrates Messages API Core to Rust
stories.blurb: By rewriting its core traffic path from Python to Rust, Anthropic lowered CPU consumption by 70% and cut time to first token by 20%.

stories.headline: Hugging Face Orchestrates 1,000-Agent Coding Swarm
stories.blurb: Hugging Face deployed 1,000 parallel DeepSeek agents to generate a lightweight chatbot, highlighting current bottlenecks in Git workflows and LLM tool execution at scale.

stories.headline: Autumn Replaces Redis with Kafka to Lower API Latency
stories.blurb: Autumn cut its API p99 latency from 108 ms to 25 ms by shifting write-behind caching logic to ordered Kafka logs and batched Postgres writes.

stories.headline: Polars 2.2 Adds Disk-Spilling Joins and Native Iceberg Support
stories.blurb: The latest Polars release enables processing datasets larger than available system memory via out-of-core joins and expands SQL write capabilities for Iceberg tables.

stories.headline: Rackspace Sunsets Spot Platform Following Security Incident
stories.blurb: Rackspace will permanently shut down its Spot Kubernetes cloud offering after a breach exposed API tokens and cluster credentials.

stories.headline: Figma Sued Over Workplace Harassment Handling
stories.blurb: A software engineer filed a lawsuit alleging Figma leadership pressured employees to directly confront individuals accused of workplace harassment under the guise of direct feedback.

stories.headline: UX Tasks Expected to Fall to AI Automation by 2030
stories.blurb: Industry analysis projects AI will outperform human designers across verifiable UX tasks such as layout generation and usability testing by the end of the decade.
